about_the_game:
Since the late 20th century, Malaysia has been plagued by a series of mysterious disappearances. People vanished without a trace, as if they had simply evaporated into thin air. Rumor has it that anyone drawn into that strange dimension will encounter horrors beyond imagination: half-bodied spirits wandering the corridors, and grotesque creatures whispering in the dark.
The truth remains unknown—only fear continues to spread.

In 2006, the protagonist Liang and the heroine Huilin are suddenly trapped in a realm woven from ghosts and illusions after a fateful elevator ride.
Within this eerie world, lost souls, twisted mysteries, and lurking terrors silently watch their every move.

They must journey through shadowed corridors, haunted hospitals, and unsettling places filled with danger, searching desperately for each other.
But what awaits them may not be reunion—it could be heartbreak, or an endless nightmare.

Your choices will decide whether they escape… or become the next wandering spirits of this realm.

Exploration & Puzzle Solving

In a complex and unfamiliar world, players will control different characters to investigate their surroundings. As the exploration deepens, more companions will join the journey, unlocking new story clues. By finding key items and solving puzzles, players can open sealed paths, overcome obstacles, and gradually uncover the truth behind the events.

Real-Time Action Combat System

The game features a fully ARPG-style real-time combat system. Enemies can appear at any moment during exploration, and players must make strategic use of weapons and skills to survive the dangers ahead.

Skill System

When facing powerful enemies, players can unleash special skills—such as slowing down time to escape danger, or briefly entering an invincible state to turn the tide of battle—adding layers of strategy and intensity to every encounter.

Multiple Endings

Decisions you make will alter the fate of the characters and the direction of the story, ultimately leading to one of five different endings.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains elements of horror and suspense. It features scenes of violence, blood, and other content that some players may find disturbing.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better (Apple Silicon via Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
